text_block_list.text:
One day, an approachable horse girl—Dantsu 
Flame— and a young girl were looking 
around restlessly, seeming quite troubled.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Um... The truth is, we're looking for 
someone to help practice making friends, 
but...~!!

text_block_list.name: Timid Girl
text_block_list.text:
I'm... transferring schools soon. So... I 
was crying because I was scared, and then 
this big sister said... "Shall we practice 
making friends together?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, well, I don't really know how 
helpful I can actually be, though~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Changing schools is super nerve-wracking, 
you know? Worrying if you'll fit in... 
I've been through that myself a lot.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
So... I really wanted to help out. That's 
why we were looking for someone to play 
the friend role!
choice_data_list: I see. In that case, I'd be glad to help.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Yay! That's great! Let's do our best 
practicing!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's practice what to do when a 
new classmate asks, "Wanna play 
together?"!

text_block_list.name: Timid Girl
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, y-yeah... Ugh... I should 
probably sound a bit more cheerful, right?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It's totally okay, don't worry! People 
don't really care that much about your 
tone of voice!

text_block_list.name: Timid Girl
text_block_list.text:
I see... Um, what should I do if I'm the 
one who wants to invite them?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I think simply showing that you want to be 
friends is what matters most. For example, 
you could say it like this—

Advice flowed smoothly and effortlessly 
from her lips. Calling it mere "experience 
from changing schools" almost felt like an 
understatement.
choice_data_list:
Have you always been good at this sort of 
thing?
Are you naturally good at this?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's just little things piling 
up~. I've made plenty of mistakes along 
the way, too.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Like trying to act super bubbly and 
burning myself out, or being way too shy 
and holding back, which made it hard to 
make friends...

text_block_list.name: Timid Girl
text_block_list.text: Is that... really true...?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but don't worry! After transferring 
again and again, I gradually started to 
figure things out!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Like, having this kind of vibe makes it 
easier for people to talk to you, or makes 
it easier to join the circle!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Maybe that's why? These days, I'm actually 
a tiny bit decent at making friends!

Her knowledge and mannerisms were 
thoroughly polished. Having transferred so 
many times—she must have put in immense 
effort.

text_block_list.name: Timid Girl
text_block_list.text:
I... I'll try my best too! Please teach 
me, Big Sis—no, Coach!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
C-Coach...! E-Ehehe, that's kind of 
embarrassing~. Let's do our best 
together~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, it's already evening?! I'm so 
sorry, I got way too carried away...!
choice_data_list:
...You've really worked hard all this 
time, haven't you?

...You've worked really hard up until now, 
huh?

We should probably head back to the 
academy soon.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, it's already evening?! I'm so 
sorry, I got way too carried away...!
choice_data_list:
...You've really worked hard all this 
time, haven't you?

...You've worked really hard up until now, 
huh?

We should probably head back to the 
academy soon.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Let's take it easy for a 
bit.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Here, have some orange juice. —Wait, huh?! 
Everyone?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yo, Dantsu! What's this about 'everyone'—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what the?! You guys are here too?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That is our line, Pocket-kun.

text_block_list.name: Timid Girl
text_block_list.text: Coach, who are these people...?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry, sorry! They're my friends from 
the academy! Pokke-chan, Tachyon-chan, and 
Cafe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Coach, is it...? Were you... having her 
check your running...?

text_block_list.name: Timid Girl
text_block_list.text:
N-No. How to make friends at my new 
school...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heh, sounds great. Dantsu fits in 
anywhere, after all. Learn all you can 
from her!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. See? Everyone is super kind. They're 
friends I made after entering the academy.

text_block_list.name: Timid Girl
text_block_list.text:
I see... Will I be able to make friends 
like that too, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
! Yep, yep, you totally can! Absolutely, 
so don't you worry at all~!

Dantsu Flame nodded with a bright smile. 
Behind her, her "friends" showed three 
distinctly different reactions— laughing, 
looking surprised, and averting eyes.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh? What is it...?
choice_data_list:
I was just thinking about how much effort 
you've put in with every transfer.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
No no, calling it effort makes it sound 
like way too big of a deal!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It's more like, while thinking 'I gotta do 
this~', before I knew it, it just became 
second nature.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It's not some grand special talent that 
helps in races or saves lives, after all—
choice_data_list:
You're helping someone out right now, 
aren't you?
You're helping someone right now, though.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Y-You're right!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I see... Thinking about it that way... 
hehe, makes me a tiny bit happy.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I tried so hard. I wish I could 
tell my past self about this...♪

text_block_list.name: Timid Girl
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for today, Coach, 
Trainer-san. I'll do my best...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! ...Thank *you* for letting me help 
out.

Dantsu Flame kept watching that little 
back until the girl was completely out of 
sight.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
You're right. If it gets too late, your 
family will start worrying.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Where do you live? Shall we 
walk you near home together?

text_block_list.name: Timid Girl
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for today. For teaching me so 
much.

text_block_list.name: Timid Girl
text_block_list.text: ...I've got to do my best, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what kind of school building do you 
think it'll be? What kind of kids will be 
there, and what kind of teacher will you 
have? Will there be after-school clubs?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
There are so many brand-new encounters 
waiting for you. I bet all of them will be 
sparkling and bright.

text_block_list.name: Timid Girl
text_block_list.text:
I see... you're right... Ehehe, I'm kind 
of looking forward to it now.

Encouraged by Dantsu Flame's words, the 
young girl's steps became noticeably 
lighter.
